prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent colored card-bottom status icon for a game, readable at 32–64 pixels.
Primary request: one simplified frontal head of Andrius, the wolf in reference image 1. This is the trial-layer icon, not the engraved approval sigil.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact character identity and palette reference. Image 2 is a style reference only: crisp simplified painted facets, dark outline, clear silhouette. Do not use its hood, human face or red palette.
Subject: a symmetrical frontal wolf head with tall upright ears, dark navy and icy-blue angular forehead, central long cyan forehead marking, small icy-blue eyes, white cheek and chin fur. Retain the recognisable face in image 1; simplify fur into large clean angular shapes.
Composition: centered square, generous fully transparent padding on every side; silhouette about 72% of canvas width and height, complete ears and mane, nothing clipped.
Style: polished game UI painted icon, a few clear value shapes, clean antialiased edge. Bold shapes for small-size readability, modest shading, no photoreal fur.
Backdrop: truly transparent alpha outside the head.
Constraints: one head only; no text, numbers, frame, circular badge, stone wall, outer glow, cast shadow, decorative particles or extra objects. Preserve solid opaque interior faces and transparency outside.
